current_measurement.lexical_count_policy: A scalar lexical reading requires both independent checkpoint groups or explicit occurrence review against both retained Schmidt scans, or a separately credited editorial adoption from a later edition. Printed editorial or reference scopes, suspect lemmas, and unresolved readings are excluded. Literal predictions and contrary readings remain available. The word projection supplies no context n-grams or positional evidence.
